Name: reserved version 2
Reason: Version Reserved2 rejected before the body is read (§2/§7); the body is valid, so only the version can be the cause

Name: reserved version 3
Reason: Version Reserved3 rejected before the body is read (§2/§7)

Name: coordinate above MaxInteger
Reason: decoded 64-bit coord X = 2^53 exceeds MaxInteger; the decoder must reject, not round (§5.1/§7)

Name: bin dimension above MaxInteger
Reason: decoded 64-bit bin Length = 2^53 exceeds MaxInteger; exercises the dimensions decode guard (bin/item dims), not coordinates (§5.1/§7)

Name: truncated body
Reason: header declares 2 items (all 8-bit) but the body ends after 1 byte of bin; the decoder must reject, not read past the end

Name: invalid gzip body
Reason: Version CompressedGzip but the body is not a valid gzip stream (no 1F 8B magic); decompression must fail (§7 step 3)
